scripts.dev: npm run build -w @pomodoro/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,server,web -c blue,green,magenta "npm:dev:shared" "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @pomodoro/shared && npm run build -w @pomodoro/server && npm run build -w @pomodoro/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p apps/server/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.node.json
